meta.source: Original CarbonGlobe dataset: Ecosystem Demography (ED) simulations
meta.sourceType: ED simulation reference outputs, not emulator predictions or observations
meta.annualSelection: December record (month index 11) for simulation years 0–40, following the benchmark; no monthly summation or averaging
meta.fluxConvention: Paper lists GPP, NPP, and Rh as annual targets in kg C m⁻²; this export preserves its December benchmark selection, not a new annual aggregation
meta.calendarConvention: Simulation years are array indices 0–40; the paper describes the historical 1981–2021 period
meta.normalization: Original stored physical values; no standardization or mean scaling
meta.sampling: Every second row and column of the original grid; original cell values, no spatial averaging
meta.coordinates: C-order nonzero mask cells; latitude = 89.75 − row × 0.5; longitude = −179.75 + column × 0.5
meta.coordinateValidation: All 3373 training and 852 test latitudes match site_lat.npz exactly; upstream preprocessing confirms C-order mask indexing. Longitude uses the standard west-to-east global cell-center convention; no explicit longitude vector is bundled
meta.trajectorySelection: Nearest available land cell to six illustrative regional anchors; sites are examples, not regional averages
meta.precision: Map values rounded to 3 decimal places; trajectories to 6 decimal places
meta.notes: Small negative model outputs are retained; age is the seed forest age. See DATA_NOTES.md for provenance and interpretation
